verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Taahaa
Maa anzalnaa alaykal-qur'aana litashqaa
Illaa tadhkiratan liman yakhshaa
Tanzeelan mimman khalaqal-arda was-samaawaatil-ulaa
Ar-Rahmaanu alal-arshi istawaa
Lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa maa baynahumaa wa maa tahtath-tharaa
Wa in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu ya'lamus-sirra wa akhfaa
Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa lahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa
Wa hal ataaka hadeethu moosaa
Idh ra'aa naaran faqaala li'hlihi umkuthoo innee aanastu naaran la-allee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu alan-naari hudaa
Falammaa ataahaa noodee yaa moosaa
Innee anaa rabbuka fakhla na'layka innaka bil-waadil-muqaddasi tuwaa
Wa anakh-tartuka fastami limaa yoohaa
Innanee anaa Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa anaa fa'budnee wa aqimis-salaata lidhikree
Innas-saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsin bimaa tas'aa
Falaa yasuddannaka anhaa man laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa
Wa maa tilka biyameenika yaa moosaa
Qaala hiya asaaya atawakka'u alayhaa wa ahushshu bihaa alaa ghanamee wa liya feehaa ma'aaribu ukhraa
Qaala alqihaa yaa moosaa
Fa-alqaahaa fa-idhaa hiya hayyatun tas'aa
Qaala khudhhaa wa laa takhaf sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal-oolaa
Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri soo'in aayatan ukhraa
Linuriyaka min aayaatinal-kubraa
Idhhab ilaa fir'awna innahu taghaa
Qaala rabbi ishrah lee sadree
Wa yassir lee amree
Wahlul uqdatan min lisaanee
Yafqahoo qawlee
Waj'al lee wazeeran min ahlee
Haaroona akhee
Ushdud bihi azree
Wa ashrikhu fee amree
Kay nusabbihaka katheeraa
Wa nadhkuraka katheeraa
Innaka kunta binaa baseeraa
Qaala qad ooteeta su'ulaka yaa moosaa
Wa laqad manannaa alayka marratan ukhraa
Idh awhaynaa ilaa ummika maa yoohaa
Aniq-dhifeehi fit-taabooti faqdhifeehi fil-yammi falyulqihil-yammu bis-saahili ya'khudhhu aduwwun lee wa-aduwwun lahu wa alqaytu alayka mahabbatan minnee wa litusna'a alaa ayn

Idh tamshee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum alaa man yakfuluhu faraja'naaka ilaa ummika kay taqarra aynuhaa wa laa tahzana wa qatalta nafsan fanajjaynaaka minal-ghammi wa fatannaaka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma ji'ta alaa qadarin yaa moosaa
Wastana'tuka linafsee
Idhhab anta wa akhooka bi-aayaatee wa laa taniyaa fee dhikree
Idhhabaa ilaa fir'awna innahu taghaa
Faqoolaa lahu qawlan layyinan la-allahu yatadhakkaru aw yakhshaa
Qaalaa rabbanaa innanaa nakhaafu an yafruta alaynaa aw an yatghaa
Qaala laa takhaafaa innanee ma'akumaa asma'u wa araa
Fa'tiyaahu faqoolaa innaa rasoolaa rabbika fa-arsil ma'anaa banee israa'eela wa laa tu'adhdhibhum qad ji'naaka bi-aayatin min rabbika was-salaamu alaa manit-taba'al-hudaa
Innaa qad oohiya ilaynaa annal-adhaaba alaa man kadhdhaba wa tawallaa
Qaala faman rabbukumaa yaa moosaa
Qaala rabbunal-ladhee a'taa kulla shay'in khalqahu thumma hadaa
Qaala famaa baalul-quroonil-oolaa
Qaala ilmuhaa inda rabbee fee kitaabin laa yadillu rabbee wa laa yansaa
Al-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda mahdan wa salaka lakum feehaa subulan wa anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-akhrajnaa bihi azwaajan min nabaatin shattaa
Kuloo war'aw an'aamakum inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin li'wlin-nuhaa
Minhaa khalaqnaakum wa feehaa nu'eedukum wa minhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa
Wa laqad araynaahu aayaatinaa kullahaa fakadhdhaba wa abaa
Qaala aji'tanaa litukhrijanaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaa moosaa
Falana'tiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faaj'al baynanaa wa baynaka maw'idan laa nukhlifuhu nahnu wa laa anta makaanan suwaa
Qaala maw'idukum yawmuz-zeenati wa an yuhsharan-naasu duhaa
Fatawallaa fir'awnu fajama'a kaydahu thumma ataa
Qaala lahum moosaa waylakum laa taftaroo alaa Allaahi kadhiban fayushitakum bi-adhaabin wa qad khaaba manif-taraa
Fatanaaza'oo amrahum baynahum wa asarrun-najwaa
Qaaloo in haadhaani lasaahiraani yureedaani an yukhrijaakum min ardikum bisihrihimaa wa yadhhabaa bitareeqatikumul-muthlaa
Fa-ajmi'oo kaydakum thumma u'too saffan wa qad aflahal-yawma manis-ta'laa
Qaaloo yaa moosaa immaa an tulqiya wa immaa an nakoona awwala man alqaa
Qaala bal alqoo fa-idhaa hibaaluhum wa isiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annahaa tas'aa
Fa-awjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moosaa
Qulnaa laa takhaf innaka antal-a'laa
Wa alqi maa fee yameenika talqaf maa sana'oo innamaa sana'oo kaydu saahirin wa laa yuflihus-saahiru haythu ataa
Fa-ulqiyas-saharatu sujjadan qaaloo aamannaa birabbi haaroona wa moosaa

Qaala aamantum lahu qabla an aadhana lakum innahu lakabeerukumul-ladhee allamakumus-sihra fala'uqatti'anna aydiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafin wa la-usallibannakum fee judhoo'in-nakhli wa lata'lamunna ayyunaa ashaddu adhaaban wa abqaa
Qaaloo lan nu'thiraka alaa maa jaa'anaa minal-bayyinaati wal-ladhee fataranaa faqdi maa anta qaadin innamaa taqdee haadhihil-hayaatad-dunyaa
Innaa aamannaa birabbinaa liyaghfira lanaa khataayaanaa wa maa akrahtanaa alayhi minas-sihri Wallaahu khayrun wa abqaa
Innahu man ya'ti rabbahu mujriman fa-inna lahu jahannama laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa
Wa man ya'tihi mu'minan qad amilas-saalihaati fa-ulaa'ika lahumud-darajaatul-ulaa
Jannaatu adnin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa dhaalika jazaa'u man tazakkaa
Wa laqad awhaynaa ilaa moosaa an asri bi-ibaadee fadrib lahum tareeqan fil-bahri yabasan laa takhaafu darakan wa laa takhshaa
Fa-atba'ahum fir'awnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum minal-yammi maa ghashiyahum
Wa adalla fir'awnu qawmahu wa maa hadaa
Yaa banee israa'eela qad anjaynaakum min aduwwikum wa waa'adnaakum jaanibat-tooril-aymana wa nazzalnaa alaykumul-manna was-salwaa
Kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum wa laa tatghaw feehi fayahilla alaykum ghadabee wa man yahlil alayhi ghadabee faqad hawaa
Wa innee laghaffaarun liman taaba wa aamana wa amila saalihan thumma ihtadaa
Wa maa a'jalaka an qawmika yaa moosaa
Qaala hum oolaa'i alaa atharee wa ajiltu ilayka rabbi litardaa
Qaala fa-innaa qad fatannaa qawmaka min ba'dika wa adallahumus-saamireey
Faraja'a moosaa ilaa qawmihi ghadbaana asifan qaala yaa qawmi alam ya'idkum rabbukum wa'dan hasanan afataala alaykumul-ahdu am aradtum an yahilla alaykum ghadabun min rabbikum fa-akhlaftum maw'idee
Qaaloo maa akhlafnaa maw'idaka bimalkinaa wa laakinnaa hummilnaa awzaaran min zeenatil-qawmi faqadhafnaahaa fakadhalika alqas-saamireey
Fa-akhraja lahum ijlan jasadan lahu khuwaarun faqaaloo haadhaa ilaahukum wa ilaahu moosaa fanasiy
Afalaa yarawna allaa yarji'u ilayhim qawlan wa laa yamliku lahum darran wa laa naf'aa
Wa laqad qaala lahum haaroonu min qablu yaa qawmi innamaa futintum bihi wa inna rabbakumur-Rahmaanu fattabi'oonee wa atee'oo amree
Qaaloo lan nabraha alayhi aakifeena hattaa yarji'a ilaynaa moosaa
Qaala yaa haaroonu maa mana'aka idh ra'aytahum dalloo
Allaa tattabi'anee afa'asayta amree
Qaala yabna'uumma laa ta'khudh bilihyatee wa laa bira'see innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israa'eela wa lam tarqub qawlee
Qaala famaa khatbuka yaa saamireey
Qaala basurtu bimaa lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min atharir-rasooli fanabadhtuhaa wa kadhalika sawwalat lee nafsee

Qaala fadhhab fa-inna laka fil-hayaati an taqoola laa misaasa wa inna laka maw'idan lan tukhlafahu wanzur ilaa ilahikal-ladhee zalta alayhi aakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fil-yammi nasfaa
Innamaa ilahukumu Allaahul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huwa wasi'a kulla shay'in ilmaa
Kadhaalika naqussu alayka min anbaa'i maa qad sabaqa wa qad aataynaaka min ladunnaa dhikraa
Man a'rada anhu fa-innahu yahmilu yawmal-qiyaamati wizraa
Khaalideena feehi wa saa'a lahum yawmal-qiyaamati himlaa
Yawma yunfakhu fis-soori wa nahshurul-mujrimeena yawma'idhin zurqaa
Yatakhaafatoona baynahum in labithtum illaa ashraa
Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona idh yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illaa yawmaa
Wa yas'aloonaka anil-jibaali faqul yansifuhaa rabbee nasfaa
Fayadharuhaa qaa'an safsafaa
Laa taraa feehaa iwajan wa laa amtaa
Yawma'idhin yattabi'oonad-daa'ee laa iwaja lahu wa khasha'atil-aswaatu lir-Rahmaani falaa tasma'u illaa hamsaa
Yawma'idhin laa tanfa'ush-shafaa'atu illaa man adhina lahur-Rahmaanu wa radiya lahu qawlaa
Ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona bihi ilmaa
Wa anatil-wujoohu lilhayyil-qayyoomi wa qad khaaba man hamala zulmaa
Wa man ya'mal minas-saalihaati wa huwa mu'minun falaa yakhaafu zulman wa laa hadmaa
Wa kadhalika anzalnaahu qur'aanan arabiyyan wa sarrafnaa feehi minal-wa-eedi la-allahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum dhikraa
Fata'aalaa Allaahul-malikul-haqqu wa laa ta'jal bil-qur'aani min qabli an yuqdaa ilayka wahyuhu wa qul rabbi zidnee ilmaa
Wa laqad ahidnaa ilaa aadama min qablu fanasiya wa lam najid lahu azmaa
Wa idh qulnaa lilmalaa'ikati usjudoo li'dama fasajadoo illaa ibleesa abaa
Faqulnaa yaa aadamu inna haadhaa aduwwun laka wa lizawjika falaa yukhrijannakumaa minal-jannati fatashqaa
Inna laka allaa tajoo'a feehaa wa laa ta'raa
Wa annaka laa tazma'u feehaa wa laa tadhaa
Fawaswasa ilayhish-shaytaanu qaala yaa aadamu hal adulluka alaa shajaratil-khuldi wa mulkin laa yablaa
Fa-akalaa minhaa fabadat lahumaa saw'aatuhumaa wa tafiqaa yakhsifaani alayhimaa min waraqil-jannati wa asaa aadamu rabbahu faghawaa
Thumma ijtabaahu rabbuhu fataaba alayhi wa hadaa
Qaalah-bitaa minhaa jamee'an ba'dukum liba'din aduwwun fa-immaa ya'tiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittaba'a hudaaya falaa yadillu wa laa yashqaa
Wa man a'rada an dhikree fa-inna lahu ma'eeshatan dankan wa nahshuruhu yawmal-qiyaamati a'maa
Qaala rabbi lima hashartanee a'maa wa qad kuntu baseeraa
Qaala kadhaalika atatka aayaatunaa fanaseetahaa wa kadhalikal-yawma tunsaa
Wa kadhalika najzee man asrafa wa lam yu'min bi-aayaati rabbihi wa la-adhaabul-aakhirati ashaddu wa abqaa
Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa qablahum minal-qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin li'wlin-nuhaa
Wa lawlaa kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakaana lizaaman wa ajalun musammaa
Fasbir alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuloo'ish-shamsi wa qabla ghuroobihaa wa min aanaa'il-layli fasabbih wa atraafan-nahaari la-allaka tardaa
Wa laa tamuddanna aynayka ilaa maa matta'naa bihi azwaajan minhum zahratal-hayaatid-dunyaa linaftinahum feehi wa rizqu rabbika khayrun wa abqaa
Wa mur ahlaka bis-salaati wastabir alayhaa laa nas'aluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka wal-aaqibatu lit-taqwaa
Wa qaaloo lawlaa ya'teenaa bi-aayatin min rabbihi awalam ta'tihim bayyinatu maa fis-suhufil-oolaa
Wa law annaa ahlaknaahum bi-adhaabin min qablihi laqaaloo rabbanaa lawlaa arsalta ilaynaa rasoolan fanattabi'a aayaatika min qabli an nadhilla wa nakhzaa
Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasata'lamoona man ashaabus-siraatis-sawiyyi wa manih-tadaa
